answer: The vault schedule is applied in voyage and vine shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1676 impostors cost 1683 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
